description: YC App Review: get a YC or a16z Speedrun application reviewed by people you trust. Use when a founder wants friends, mentors or alumni to review their YC or Speedrun application, or asks to share their draft for feedback. Builds a shareable review page (one HTML file, application-portal look) where reviewers leave notes per question and press "Send my notes" to send them back as text, then parses the notes into proposed rewrites. Optional tracked private links per reviewer. Works for YC and a16z Speedrun. Not affiliated with Y Combinator or a16z.
